thread:
maria-billing: Heads up — we detected delayed token ingestion affecting ~22 accounts over the last 24h. Seeing ~+12% token delta vs expected on a subset of invoices. Need owners + timeline to contain and correct. pinging infra/plat/finance @sam-platform @alex-finance

sam-platform: On it, starting triage now. Can you drop the affected account IDs or a link to the list? @maria-billing

maria-billing: List uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/sheets/INV-1748 (shared). I added sample invoice IDs and deltas.

alex-finance: How many invoices already issued? Do we need immediate reissues or can we credit first? cc @nora-ops

jamie-sre: We saw a backoff spike in batch job `token_ingest_v2` ~02:10 UTC. Restarted worker pool, backlog resumed. Running a dedupe pass to avoid double counts.

chris-ml: Preliminary root cause: new retry enhancer in dedupe lib caused idempotence key collision when payloads get truncated; duplicated entries got ingested. PR: https://git.redwood/pr/4821

lee-eng: Infra/plat should own the roll-forward patch + tests. I can add a focused idempotence test in the library.

sam-platform: I'll own the fix + rollout. ETA patch + canary: ~6h. Plan: patch dedupe lib, run canary, then reingest backlog. Quick reingest dry-run command:```bash
python tools/reingest.py --from 2024-06-01 --to 2024-06-02 --dry-run
```

jamie-sre: Containment for now: disabled enhanced retry across cluster. Token ingestion lag down to 0-10m. Monitoring closely.

maria-billing: Ownership summary: @sam-platform = fix + rollout, @lee-eng = tests, @alex-finance = invoice reissue policy, @nora-ops = credits/customer comms. Timeline: patch in 6h, full reingest in ~24h, invoice correction plan in 48h.

alex-finance: Proposal for invoice reissue: reissue if delta > $50 OR delta > 10% of invoice total. Else issue credit memo. If we need to reissue >30 days back, legal signoff required. Thoughts?

nora-ops: Acknowledged. I'll draft credit memo + customer FAQ. ETA 48h.

sam-platform: Patch PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/4830 — includes idempotence test and rollback guard. Requesting reviews from @lee-eng and @chris-ml.

lee-eng: Reviewing now. Left comments re: edge-case when payload trimmed. Will add unit tests and a fuzz case.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of PR 4830 to `dedupe-cluster` started by @sam-platform at 1748002234.

jamie-sre: Canary looks healthy after 30m — no ingestion errors in canary partition. Expanding to 25%.

sam-platform: Rolling to 100%. Post-rollout reingest scheduled for 2024-06-02T04:00Z (approx 18h). Will run diff job after reingest.

alex-finance: After reingest completes I'll run ledger diff + generate invoice corrections list and a prioritized reissue queue.

maria-billing: Setting remediation cadence: weekly sync every Wed 14:00 PST until closure. I'll add calendar invite and link to incident doc.

jamie-sre: :thumbsup: I'll add a runbook section to the incident doc with watch signals (ingest error rate, ledger divergence, reissue queue size).

nora-ops: Also prepping customer comms draft + FAQ. Will pair with @maria-billing on tone and credit thresholds.

maria-billing: Summary doc link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1748-remediation — will keep updated with timelines and customer list.

sam-platform: Note: if we need to provide immediate credits before reissue, @alex-finance can approve ad-hoc credits up to $200/customer to keep CS response low-latency.

alex-finance: Ack.

jamie-sre: Next check-in: in 12h or after reingest completes, whichever is earlier. I'll post reingest health and ledger diff results to this thread.

maria-billing: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick responses.
